summary: Underneath it, you swing between deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you read people and care on instinct; other days you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: Underneath it, you swing between deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you read people and care on instinct; other days you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver. The work is holding both without picking a side. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend. Comfort may be complicated by excess or expectation. Care can feel abundant at times, then difficult to measure or trust at others.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need - or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let emotional needs and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Warmth and generosity that draw people in; watch the tendency to overextend.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
